evidence_kind: read-only source inspection; no new native test, hashing, normalization or timing
library_policy: General built-in or third-party regex engines are permitted. The application must specify and perform the prescribed counts and ordered substitutions. Results measure the complete application and its selected engine, not isolated compiler speed.

mech.counting_case_policy: case-sensitive: RegexBuilder uses unicode(false), without case_insensitive(true)

matlab.saved_canonical_output_checks: Prior preserved measurement records report passing canonical output checks; no checks were rerun during this inspection.

c3_candidate.authored_work: Patterns, non-overlapping search/count loops, replacement span assembly, ordered substitutions, threading, I/O and generic ABI glue

semantic_followup.finding: MATLAB counting ignores case while Mech and the inspected canonical upstream implementations match case. This can differ for arbitrary mixed-case inputs even when canonical output checks pass.
semantic_followup.required_correction: Preserve the existing MATLAB sources and measurements. Author additive regex sources using case-sensitive regexp; verify a mixed-case counterexample and the complete prescribed work, then obtain new bounded and full measurements tied to the new exact sources before admitting replacement rows.
semantic_followup.proposed_counterexample: FASTA record containing agggtaaa followed by AGGGTAAA; case-sensitive first-pattern count is 1, case-insensitive count is 2. This is a predicted semantic counterexample, not a claimed executed test.
